one_liner: Salesforce has a broad REST API with OAuth 2.0 and a free Developer Edition org with API access. Commercial or multi-customer apps must enroll in the ISV/AppExchange Partner Program under the API terms. The MCP claim isn't confirmed by the fetched pages.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 via a Connected App or External Client App (consumer key/secret). The draft's SOAP login() username/password method isn't supported by the fetched pages, so it was dropped.
access_notes: Developer Edition orgs have API access enabled by default. The signup is linked from the docs, and the homepage says "No credit card needed". Production customer orgs need Enterprise, Performance or Unlimited, or a Professional Edition add-on. Group and Essentials have no API. Commercial or multi-customer apps must be enrolled in the ISV Partner Program. Free apps and single-customer apps are exempt.
blocker_notes: The API terms bar Commercial Use unless the app is enrolled in the ISV Partner Program. Each customer org also needs an API-enabled edition and a Connected or External Client App.

evidence.quote: API access is enabled by default in Enterprise, Performance, Unlimited, and Developer Edition orgs. Professional Edition orgs can add API access as an add-on.
